products.name: SaaS Application Discovery & License Right-Sizing — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to discover SaaS applications and right-size licenses — surface real usage from sign-in telemetry, reclaim unused and duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, and bring SaaS spend under control. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Find the SaaS you're overpaying for — and right-size every seat

SaaS sprawl is the new shadow IT: teams buy apps directly, seats are bought and forgotten, and nobody has a full picture of SaaS spend. This solution gives you a repeatable way to discover SaaS applications and right-size licenses — surface what's actually in use from sign-in and usage telemetry, identify unused and duplicate seats, consolidate overlapping tools, and bring SaaS spend under control.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the SaaS sprawl problem, discovery via Entra ID sign-ins / app telemetry, the right-sizing levers (reclaim, consolidate, downgrade), and the ongoing review cycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID sign-in/usage data, app owner contacts, SaaS admin access where available, a spend baseline) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: discover SaaS apps and usage, map owners and spend, identify unused/duplicate/overlapping seats, right-size and consolidate, set a recurring review, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SaaS app/usage discovery (Entra ID sign-ins), seat-utilization validation, a SaaS spend and right-sizing report, safe remediation (flag/reclaim candidates), and a review-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

SaaS spend under control — apps discovered, unused and duplicate seats reclaimed, overlapping tools consolidated — with a recurring review to keep it that way, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SAASLIC-Discovery.ps1 — discover Entra ID SaaS (enterprise) apps and per-app sign-in activity
    • SAASLIC-Remediation.ps1 — flag dormant-seat reclaim candidates (safe; default -WhatIf)
    • SAASLIC-Report.ps1 — SaaS spend and right-sizing report: entitled seats vs active users
    • SAASLIC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/refresh the 'Review Scope - SaaS' Entra ID group
    • SAASLIC-Validation.ps1 — confirm Graph connectivity and the read access this solution needs

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
